LanguageData.RHA_TeamMark027.label: relay opening
LanguageData.RHA_TeamMark027.description: An opening for a teammate. Becomes invalid if its owner leaves the map, is downed or loses the card.
LanguageData.RHA_TeamStatus027.label: team relays
LanguageData.RHA_TeamStatus027.description: Inspect relay targets, remaining time, recovery and trigger counts. Shields use the higher value with other ordinary shields rather than adding. Added damage ignores damage bonuses; these shields ignore healing amplification.
